_readme: Draft Wansford walk. [[c:...]] = cyan, not confirmed. Positions are guesses until recorded on site.
name: The Papermills

layers.essential_history: [[c:The Papermills is one of Wansford's inns, close to the bridge on the old road.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Wansford grew up as a stopping place for travellers crossing the Nene.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:The ostler shows you a coded tag tied to the coach guard's lantern.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:The lantern tag]]
puzzle.intro: [[c:A is 1, B is 2, C is 3, and so on.]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Whose lantern is it? (job)]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:7 21 1 18 4 spells GUARD. It's the coach guard's lantern, found by the bridge.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

evidence: [[c:The coach guard's lantern was found near the bridge.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head south-east, about 100 metres as the crow flies, to the Cross Keys.  Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
